title: Genetic Epistasis Analysis: Are Combined Steering Effects Additive or Non-Linear?

original_idea.body: Apply genetics epistasis framework to 2^3 on/off combinations of three safety steering vectors; quantify pairwise and three-way interactions. Inference-only.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: higher-order interactions among stacked safety steers matter for defense-in-depth, but the link is one step broader (level 3).

accessible_complexity.reasoning: 2^3 factorial + interaction model; clear methodology, statistics-friendly, novice+mentor feasible (level 4).

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable (epistasis quantification for 3 vectors), clean factorial design (level 4).

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly inference-only interaction study on open models (level 4).

novelty.reasoning: Epistasis framing for higher-order steering interactions appears mostly novel.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Higher-order epistasis analysis of steering combinations appears underexplored.
